title: "Traditions (Entry Tags)"
output:

    toc: true

# Overview

Do religious traditions differ, and is the change over time **within** traditions or **replacement**
(traditions with high values becoming more common)? Groups only, conditional answers (child questions as
answered), plus the two parent questions.

Traditions come from the entry tags (`1_code_entrytags.py`): six flags (christian, islamic, jewish, buddhist,
hindu, chinese), "other" if none. 5% of group entries have more than one flag (mostly Chinese Buddhism and
Christianity in China; "chinese" is the broad Chinese-sphere flag). We use **multiple membership**
(`mm()` in brms): an entry with *k* traditions gets the average of their effects (weights 1/*k*). For
comparison, one model uses a single **priority** label (Islamic > Buddhist > Christian > Jewish > Hindu > Chinese > Other).

Models (each question separately; time = (`year_from` - 1000) / 1000, so **0 = 1000 CE**):

| model | formula |
|---|---|
| M0 | `time + (1 | world_region)` |
| M1-priority | `time + (1 | tradition) + (1 | world_region)` |
| M1-mm | `time + (1 | mm(traditions)) + (1 | world_region)` |
| M2-mm | `time + (1 + time | mm(traditions)) + (1 | world_region)` |
| M1b-mm | `time + (1 | mm(traditions))` (no world region) |

- `b_time` in M0 vs. M1-mm: if the slope stays, the change is within traditions; if it shrinks, replacement.
- M1-priority vs. M1-mm: how much the priority label matters.
- M2-mm: tradition-specific slopes.
- M1b-mm vs. M1-mm: how much traditions and world regions overlap.

Priors as in `4_baseline.Rmd` (intercept normal(0, 1.5), slopes normal(0, 1), SDs exponential(1); brms
default lkj(1) for the intercept-slope correlation in M2-mm). Conflicting answers weighted 1/n.

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (delete them to refit),
figures in `fig/entrytags/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/entrytags/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/entrytags"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

# traditions (colors as in temporal/plot_traditions_time.py)
traditions <- c("christian", "islamic", "jewish", "buddhist", "hindu", "chinese", "other")
tradition_colors <- c(
  christian = "#2a78d6", islamic = "#eb6834", jewish = "#e87ba4", buddhist = "#1baf7a",
  hindu = "#008300", chinese = "#eda100", other = "#898781"
)
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  mutate(time = (year_from - 1000) / 1000)

parent_questions <- c("supernatural monitoring present", "supreme high god present")
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(parent_questions, topic_order)

questions <- d |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "shg")))

# groups only: parent questions and child questions (conditional)
d_model <- d |>
  filter(poll == "group") |>
  filter(question_short %in% parent_questions | (family != "parent" & !inferred))
```

Entries per tradition (priority label, and any membership):

```{r data_traditions}
entries <- d_model |> distinct(entry_id, tradition, trad1, trad2, trad3)
tibble(
  tradition = traditions,
  priority = map_int(traditions, ~ sum(entries$tradition == .x)),
  membership = map_int(traditions, ~ sum(entries$trad1 == .x | entries$trad2 == .x | entries$trad3 == .x))
)
```

Time range per tradition (any membership; `year_from`):

```{r data_time}
map_dfr(traditions, function(t) {
  entries_t <- d_model |> filter(trad1 == t | trad2 == t | trad3 == t) |> distinct(entry_id, year_from)
  tibble(tradition = t, entries = nrow(entries_t), min = min(entries_t$year_from),
         median = median(entries_t$year_from), max = max(entries_t$year_from))
})
```

# Models

```{r models}
mm_term <- "mm(trad1, trad2, trad3, weights = cbind(w1, w2, w3), scale = FALSE)"
formulas <- list(
  m0 = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | world_region)),
  m1_priority = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | tradition) + (1 | world_region)),
  m1_mm = bf(as.formula(paste("answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 |", mm_term, ") + (1 | world_region)"))),
  m2_mm = bf(as.formula(paste("answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 + time |", mm_term, ") + (1 | world_region)"))),
  m1b_mm = bf(as.formula(paste("answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 |", mm_term, ")")))
)
model_labels <- c(m0 = "M0", m1_priority = "M1-priority", m1_mm = "M1-mm", m2_mm = "M2-mm", m1b_mm = "M1b-mm (no region)")
model_colors <- c(m0 = "#898781", m1_priority = "#eda100", m1_mm = "#2a78d6", m2_mm = "#1baf7a", m1b_mm = "#e87ba4")

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
```

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- map(formulas, function(formula) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = d_model, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors, chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(model, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/entrytags_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(d_model, question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(model = names(formulas), question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(fit = map2(model, question, fit_question), model = factor(model, levels = names(formulas)))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_|^cor_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per model
diagnostics |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail), divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Within traditions or replacement?

```{r estimates}
# posterior summaries of population-level effects, SDs and correlations, per fit
estimates <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_|^cor_", regex = TRUE) |>
      summarise_draws(mean, ~ quantile(.x, c(0.025, 0.975))) |>
      rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`)
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)))

coef_plot <- function(est, xlab) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = model)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Time slopes

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years (95% interval). In M2-mm this is the average slope across traditions.

```{r slopes, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 12}
p_slopes <- estimates |> filter(variable == "b_time") |> coef_plot("Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)")
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 9, 12)
```

## Spread of traditions and world regions

SDs of the tradition intercepts (priority and multiple membership), of the world-region intercepts, and of the
tradition slopes (M2-mm).

```{r sds, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
p_sds <- estimates |>
  filter(str_starts(variable, "sd_")) |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    str_detect(variable, "world_region") ~ "world region (intercept)",
    str_detect(variable, "__time") ~ "tradition (slope)",
    TRUE ~ "tradition (intercept)"
  )) |>
  coef_plot("SD (log-odds)") +
  facet_grid(family ~ term, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_sds, "sds", 12, 12)
```

# Traditions

## Levels

Tradition intercepts (M1-mm; posterior mean, log-odds at 1000 CE relative to the average tradition).
Numbers in the tiles: entries with that tradition (any membership) for that question.

```{r levels, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 11}
tradition_n <- map_dfr(traditions, function(t) {
  d_model |>
    filter(trad1 == t | trad2 == t | trad3 == t) |>
    group_by(question = question_short) |>
    summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id)) |>
    mutate(tradition = t)
})

tradition_effects <- function(model, group, coef = "Intercept") {
  fits |>
    filter(model == !!model) |>
    mutate(re = map(fit, function(fit) {
      r <- ranef(fit)[[group]][, , coef]
      tibble(tradition = rownames(r), estimate = r[, "Estimate"], lower = r[, "Q2.5"], upper = r[, "Q97.5"])
    })) |>
    select(question, re) |>
    unnest(re)
}

levels_mm <- tradition_effects("m1_mm", "mmtrad1trad2trad3") |>
  left_join(tradition_n, by = c("question", "tradition")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)), tradition = factor(tradition, levels = traditions))

p_levels <- ggplot(levels_mm, aes(tradition, question, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 2.3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "white", high = "#eb6834", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "log-odds") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot(p_levels, "levels", 8, 11)
```

Priority label vs. multiple membership: tradition intercepts of M1-priority against M1-mm (one point per
question and tradition; line: equal).

```{r priority_vs_mm, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
levels_priority <- tradition_effects("m1_priority", "tradition")
p_priority <- levels_priority |>
  inner_join(levels_mm |> mutate(question = as.character(question), tradition = as.character(tradition)),
             by = c("question", "tradition"), suffix = c("_priority", "_mm")) |>
  ggplot(aes(estimate_mm, estimate_priority, colour = tradition)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = tradition_colors) +
  labs(x = "M1-mm (log-odds)", y = "M1-priority (log-odds)", colour = NULL)
save_plot(p_priority, "priority_vs_mm", 6, 5)
```

## Slopes per tradition

Time slope per tradition (M2-mm: average slope + tradition deviation; posterior mean, log-odds per 1,000 years;
\* = 95% interval excludes 0).

```{r tradition_slopes, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 11}
slopes_mm <- fits |>
  filter(model == "m2_mm") |>
  mutate(co = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- coef(fit)$mmtrad1trad2trad3[, , "time"]
    tibble(tradition = rownames(s), estimate = s[, "Estimate"], lower = s[, "Q2.5"], upper = s[, "Q97.5"])
  })) |>
  select(question, co) |>
  unnest(co) |>
  left_join(tradition_n, by = c("question", "tradition")) |>
  mutate(
    question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)),
    tradition = factor(tradition, levels = traditions),
    label = if_else(lower > 0 | upper < 0, "*", "")
  )

p_tradition_slopes <- ggplot(slopes_mm, aes(tradition, question, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4, colour = "grey20", vjust = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "white", high = "#eb6834", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "slope") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot(p_tradition_slopes, "tradition_slopes", 8, 11)
```

## Curves per tradition

P(yes) over time per tradition (average world region; mean), drawn only within the time range of that
tradition's entries for that question. M1-mm: one common slope, traditions differ in level (curves are
parallel on the log-odds scale). M2-mm: each tradition has its own slope.
Black dashed line: the population-level curve ($\alpha + \beta \cdot$ time, tradition effect 0), over the
time range of all entries for that question: an average tradition in M1-mm, a typical tradition in M2-mm.

```{r curves_function}
# P(yes) per tradition on a grid within its observed time range, for one model (tradition term only),
# plus the population-level curve ("overall", no group-level effects) over the range of all entries
tradition_curves <- function(model, re_formula) {
  fits |>
    filter(model == !!model) |>
    mutate(curve = map2(fit, question, function(fit, question) {
      per_tradition <- map_dfr(traditions, function(t) {
        years <- d_model |> filter(question_short == question, trad1 == t | trad2 == t | trad3 == t) |> pull(year_from)
        if (length(years) < 2) return(NULL)
        newdata <- tibble(year = seq(min(years), max(years), length.out = 50)) |>
          mutate(time = (year - 1000) / 1000, trad1 = t, trad2 = t, trad3 = t, w1 = 1, w2 = 0, w3 = 0, weight = 1)
        p <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = re_formula, ndraws = 1000)
        newdata |> mutate(tradition = t, mean = colMeans(p))
      })
      years <- d_model |> filter(question_short == question) |> pull(year_from)
      newdata <- tibble(year = seq(min(years), max(years), length.out = 100), time = (year - 1000) / 1000, weight = 1)
      p <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA, ndraws = 1000)
      bind_rows(per_tradition, newdata |> mutate(tradition = "overall", mean = colMeans(p)))
    })) |>
    select(question, curve) |>
    unnest(curve)
}

curve_plot <- function(curves) {
  curves <- curves |> mutate(tradition = factor(tradition, levels = c(traditions, "overall")))
  ggplot(curves, aes(year, mean, colour = tradition, linetype = tradition == "overall")) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(tradition_colors, overall = "black")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "solid", "TRUE" = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(-2000, 2025)) +
    labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

M1-mm (common slope):

```{r curves_m1, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 20}
curves_m1 <- tradition_curves("m1_mm", as.formula(paste("~ (1 |", mm_term, ")")))
p_curves_m1 <- curve_plot(curves_m1)
save_plot(p_curves_m1, "curves_m1", 12, 20)
```

M2-mm (slopes per tradition):

```{r curves, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 20}
curves <- tradition_curves("m2_mm", as.formula(paste("~ (1 + time |", mm_term, ")")))
p_curves <- curve_plot(curves)
save_plot(p_curves, "curves", 12, 20)
```

# Model comparison (LOO)

Difference in expected log predictive density (elpd; positive = first model predicts better; 95% interval
as ±1.96 SE). LOO results are saved in `fits/` as well.

```{r loo}
loo_question <- function(model, question, fit) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/entrytags_loo_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  l <- loo(fit)
  saveRDS(l, path)
  l
}
loos <- fits |> mutate(loo = pmap(list(as.character(model), question, fit), loo_question))

# Pareto k > 0.7 (unreliable LOO estimate) per model
loos |>
  mutate(high_k = map_int(loo, ~ sum(.x$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(fits_with_high_k = sum(high_k > 0), observations_high_k = sum(high_k))

elpd_diff <- function(a, b) {
  diff <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  tibble(mean = sum(diff), se = sqrt(length(diff)) * sd(diff))
}
loo_of <- function(model, question) loos$loo[[which(loos$model == model & loos$question == question)]]

comparisons <- tribble(
  ~first, ~second, ~comparison,
  "m1_mm", "m0", "M1-mm vs. M0 (traditions)",
  "m1_priority", "m0", "M1-priority vs. M0 (traditions, priority)",
  "m1_mm", "m1_priority", "M1-mm vs. M1-priority",
  "m2_mm", "m1_mm", "M2-mm vs. M1-mm (tradition slopes)",
  "m1_mm", "m1b_mm", "M1-mm vs. M1b-mm (world regions)"
)
loo_diffs <- crossing(comparisons, question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(diff = pmap(list(first, second, question), ~ elpd_diff(loo_of(..1, ..3), loo_of(..2, ..3)))) |>
  unnest(diff) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)), comparison = factor(comparison, levels = comparisons$comparison))
```

```{r loo_plot, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 11}
p_loo <- ggplot(loo_diffs, aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean - 1.96 * se, xmax = mean + 1.96 * se), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(family ~ comparison, scales = "free", space = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(20)) +
  labs(x = "elpd difference", y = NULL)
save_plot(p_loo, "loo", 14, 11)
```

## All models together

Per question, elpd of each model relative to the best model for that question (best = 0; 95% interval of the
difference as ±1.96 SE). Models within about 4 elpd of the best predict practically equally well.

```{r loo_relative, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 12}
loo_relative <- loos |>
  group_by(question) |>
  group_modify(function(x, key) {
    best <- x$loo[[which.max(map_dbl(x$loo, ~ .x$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"]))]]
    tibble(model = x$model, diff = map(x$loo, ~ elpd_diff(.x, best))) |> unnest(diff)
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)))

p_loo_relative <- ggplot(loo_relative, aes(mean, question, colour = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -4, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean - 1.96 * se, xmax = mean + 1.96 * se), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-40, 0)) +
  labs(x = "elpd relative to the best model (axis cut at -40)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_loo_relative, "loo_relative", 9, 12)
```

Stacking weights per question (how much each model contributes to the best weighted combination of the
five; weights sum to 1 per question):

```{r loo_weights, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 11}
stacking <- loos |>
  group_by(question) |>
  group_modify(function(x, key) {
    w <- loo_model_weights(setNames(x$loo, as.character(x$model)), method = "stacking")
    tibble(model = names(w), weight = as.numeric(w))
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)), model = factor(model, levels = names(formulas)))

p_loo_weights <- ggplot(stacking, aes(model, question, fill = weight)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(weight >= 0.05, sprintf("%.2f", weight), "")), size = 2.3) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = model_labels) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2a78d6", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "weight") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot(p_loo_weights, "loo_weights", 8, 11)
```

Summary over the 38 questions: how often each model is best, within 4 elpd of the best, and its average
stacking weight; NB. m2_mm might be better as m2_priority actually, so maybe this is actually what is "best" by IC. 

```{r loo_summary}
loo_relative |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(best = sum(mean == 0), within_4 = sum(mean > -4)) |>
  left_join(stacking |> group_by(model) |> summarise(mean_weight = round(mean(weight), 2)), by = "model")
```

# Posterior predictive checks

Observed share yes (points) against the 95% posterior predictive interval (bars) per tradition (priority
label), for M0 (no traditions) and M2-mm.

```{r ppc}
ppc_tradition <- function(fit, data) {
  yrep <- posterior_predict(fit, ndraws = 1000)
  map_dfr(intersect(traditions, unique(data$tradition)), function(t) {
    w <- data$weight * (data$tradition == t)
    prop <- as.vector(yrep %*% w) / sum(w)
    tibble(tradition = t, observed = sum(w * data$answer_value) / sum(w),
           lower = quantile(prop, 0.025), upper = quantile(prop, 0.975))
  })
}

ppc <- fits |>
  filter(model %in% c("m0", "m2_mm")) |>
  mutate(check = map2(fit, question, ~ ppc_tradition(.x, filter(d_model, question_short == .y)))) |>
  select(model, question, check) |>
  unnest(check)
```

```{r ppc_plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 22}
p_ppc <- ppc |>
  mutate(tradition = factor(tradition, levels = rev(traditions))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = tradition, colour = model)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = observed), size = 1.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels) +
  labs(x = "Share yes", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_ppc, "ppc_tradition", 12, 22)
```

Share of observed values outside the 95% interval:

```{r ppc_summary}
ppc |>
  mutate(outside = observed < lower | observed > upper) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(groups = n(), share_outside = round(mean(outside), 2), outside = sum(outside), .groups = "drop")
```
